title: Bootstrapping the Four-Point NMHV Stress-Tensor Form Factor
summary: We bootstrap the four-point next-to-maximally helicity-violating (NMHV) form factor of the chiral stress-tensor supermultiplet in planar maximally supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory through three loops at the symbol level. At two loops, an ansatz built from NMHV leading singularities and the relevant five-point one-mass integral function space is fixed uniquely by physical constraints; the resulting ratio function symbol contains 78 letters, all drawn from the 88-letter alphabet previously identified in the four-point MHV sector.
